newsitem.title: PERU: Doctor warns of epidemic risk among Peru hostages.
newsitem.headline: Doctor warns of epidemic risk among Peru hostages.

text.p: The captives in Peru's embassy crisis face possible epidemics of cholera and diarrhoea because of the unsanitary conditions in which Marxist gunmen are holding them, a top local doctor said on Saturday.

"There could be an outbreak ... of cholera and diarrhoea because of the lack of water," Peruvian Medical Federation president Max Cardenas told reporters outside the besieged Japanese embassy residence in Lima.

Cardenas said that so far no really serious health problems had occurred inside the building, where Tupac Amaru Revolutionary Movement (MRTA) rebels are holding about 340 hostages, among them ambassadors and top government officials.

Running water to the residence has been cut off on government orders and officials have ignored repeated hostage and rebel pleas to restore the service. Bottled water for drinking has been delivered periodically.
